# Maersk Says Hopedale Chosen for Strategic Northeast Location

Wed, July 22, 2026 by Tyler Lawton

HOPEDALE – Global logistics company Maersk says Hopedale’s location played a key role in its decision to build a new $100 million fulfillment center in town.

As previously announced, the 617,000-square-foot facility is expected to create approximately 1,000 jobs and begin operations in August.

According to a company spokesperson speaking with the Milford Daily News, Hopedale was selected because of its “strategic location,” allowing Maersk to position inventory closer to customers as it continues expanding its North American logistics network.

- - Athletic apparel company creating more than 400 jobs

Jackson, Miss. (Oct. 12, 2026) – ALO, the fashion and lifestyle brand synonymous with premium studio-to-streetwear rooted in mind-body wellness, is locating a new national fulfillment and distribution center in Southaven. The project represents a corporate investment of nearly $176 million and will create more than 400 new jobs.

ALO is moving into an existing building and will occupy up to 1.2 million square feet, with the option to add returns processing operations at the facility.

The Mississippi Development Authority is providing assistance through the Mississippi Flexible Tax Incentive, or MFLEX, program. DeSoto County and the city of Southaven are assisting with the project, as well.

ALO began operations in August and plans to fill the new jobs by 2027.

Walmart Opens Next-Generation Fulfillment Center in Stockton, Expanding Faster Delivery Across the West Coast

# Walmart Opens Next-Generation Fulfillment Center in Stockton, Expanding Faster Delivery Across the West Coast

Oct. 8, 2026

 

## New facility will create 1,000+ jobs and use advanced automation and technology to increase fulfillment capacity

STOCKTON, Calif., Oct. 8, 2026 — Walmart today opened its fifth next-generation fulfillment center, a more than 900,000-square-foot facility in Stockton that will create more than 1,000 jobs and expand the retailer’s ability to provide faster shipping and delivery to customers across California and the West Coast.

The new facility represents the latest step in Walmart’s transformation of its supply chain, bringing associates together with advanced automation, technology and machine learning to move products faster and more efficiently. The technology enables Walmart to materially improve storage capacity and increase the number of customer orders the facility can fulfill each day compared with a traditional fulfillment center.

# New Spalding County warehouse holds groundbreaking ceremony 

- By AVERI CALDWELL Managing Editor acaldwell@griffindailynews.com
- Oct 8, 2026 
- Oct 8, 2026

GRIFFIN — Last week a new cold storage warehouse facility held its groundbreaking ceremony with many community leaders in attendance.

The new facility NewCold is expanding its Georgia presence into Spalding County with what the Griffin-Spalding Development Authority said will soon be the largest single development in the county’s history. The development will also be one of the largest NewCold developments in the world.

NewCold’s Griffin location will be a new addition to the High Falls Industrial Park.

“This is a great project for our county,” said Nat Doughtie, chair of the development authority. “We’re excited to see the facility come up and welcome y’all to our community going forward.”

NewCold was founded in the Netherlands and has an office in Chicago with facilities and operations in nine countries. It specializes in automated warehousing and distribution, partnering with some of the largest food companies in the world.
